title: Moondrop Pendant
summary: At 50% HP or below, movement no longer provokes Opportunity Attacks.

fields.Writhing Dance: When the wearer has 50% HP or less, they do not provoke Opportunity Attacks. The threshold is checked after taking damage or healing in the current region after loading. Equipping the pendant below half HP alone does not activate it.
fields.Acquisition: Selûnite gilded chest in the Owlbear Nest. Find the prayer sheet behind the statue and read it near the chest to open it.

changes: Added native BG3 rules using pinned item and linked gameplay sources.
